全國智慧運算與量子資訊創新應用競賽: National Intelligent Computing & Quantum Information Competition
比較量子演算法 RQAOA 和傳統方法，跑了 116 個題目，研究公開在 Git: Compared the quantum algorithm RQAOA with classical methods on 116 problem instances. The research is public on GitHub.
我想知道量子演算法 RQAOA 在真實的排程問題上，到底能不能贏過一般電腦的方法: I wanted to know whether RQAOA can actually beat ordinary computers on real scheduling problems. I tested paint-shop color changes, MAX-k-CUT, 3-coloring and Wi-Fi channel planning — 116 instances in total.
噴漆換色上，RQAOA 比一個專用的傳統方法好大約 12–14%；換成更強的禁忌: On paint-shop scheduling, RQAOA beat a dedicated classical method by about 12–14%, but lost to a stronger tabu search. I wrote up why it lost as a failure analysis.
另外做了「量子適用性健檢」，讓量子和古典方法在企業的小樣本資料上正面比較。兩個研: I also built a Quantum Fit Check that compares quantum and classical methods head-to-head on small business datasets. Both projects are public on GitHub.
TRC 競賽 XY 平衡模塊: Taiwan Robot Competition　XY balance module
隊伍「蠑螈」，我負責機械構想和製作。: Team Salamander. I led the mechanical concept and build.
這是裝在物流無人車上的配重補償模組。工廠常把貨物疊得很高，無人車轉彎、煞車或被撞: A counterweight module for warehouse robots. Factories stack loads high, so robots can tip over when they turn, brake or get bumped — most sites just slow them down.
我們在載台四個角裝荷重元量受力，算出往哪個方向快要倒，再用 X、Y 兩軸的皮帶帶: Load cells at the four corners measure force and work out which way the load is about to tip. Belts on the X and Y axes then move a counterweight to compensate. Each axis runs four 775 motors in sync, and the weight moves on PID plus S-curve control so it doesn't shake the robot.
8 頁技術說明書裡的初步模擬：加裝後靜態傾倒臨界力提升約 11–12%。接下來要: Initial simulation in our 8-page technical report: the module raises the static tipping threshold by about 11–12%. Next up are real tests of the counterweight, response and loaded driving.

「破土重圓：從影像辨識到快速評估」，擔任隊長，和學長的團隊一起送件。: "Rebuilding the Ground: from image recognition to rapid assessment." I was team captain, working with upperclassmen.
戰時機場跑道常是第一個被攻擊的目標，越快修好越能恢復起降。我們的想法分四步：無人: In a conflict, runways are often hit first, and the faster they're repaired the sooner aircraft can fly. Our plan has four steps: drones photograph the runway; YOLO finds the craters (trained with potholes as negative examples to avoid false alarms); 3D Gaussian Splatting rebuilds a model to estimate crater volume; and AI estimates materials and crew and orders the repairs.
